provenance: Frozen independent anchors for the DoD trial-count heatmap (2B / G11, declared 2026-09-13 BEFORE any production change). Derived by hand from the contrast algebra of a four-event difference of differences under the retained pairwise harmonic-mean covariance scaler (Rocha et al., 2026, Table 6 convention): u = c' Sp c; bt_scaled = sum_i c_i^2 Sb_ii/n_i + sum_{i<j} 2 c_i c_j Sb_ij / H(n_i,n_j) with H the harmonic mean; er_scaled = sum_i c_i^2 E_i/n_i; D = u/(u + bt_scaled + er_scaled); G = u/(u + er_scaled). The audit record is finding PBA-07 / G11 (classical-alignment review of 2026-09-12, with its executed probe; local development evidence). No value here was read from psyrat_startview_dodiff.m, psyrat_dodiffrel.m or PsyRATAccuracyOracle.m.

anchors.name: psd_block_unequal_counts
anchors.description: PSD between-trial block [[1,2],[2,4]] on events 1-2, all other trial entries 0; universe diag([1,0,0,0]); residual variances [1,1,1,1]; counts [1,100,1,1]. The harmonic-scaled trial contrast is negative while the final dependability lies inside [0,1], so a range-only mask calls the cell valid.

anchors.name: psd_block_equal_counts_control
anchors.description: Same components at counts [1,1,1,1]: harmonic, geometric and arithmetic means coincide, so the projected block is the raw block and every quantity is a variance.

anchors.name: strict_pd_block_unequal_counts
anchors.description: Strictly positive-definite raw block: [[1,1.9],[1.9,4]] on events 1-2 (det .39) plus .1 on the two remaining trial diagonals. No PSD test of the raw block can catch this; only the projected component check does. Counts [1,100,1,1].

anchors.name: two_draw_nonlinear_summary
anchors.description: Two equally weighted admissible draws with universe variance 1 and 9, residual error 1 at one trial, no trial variance. Posterior mean of the draw-level ratios (the table) is .7; the plug-in ratio of posterior mean components (the heatmap) is 5/6. Both are correct under their own label; they are distinct summaries, not a scientific choice left open.

closed_forms.psd_block_first_heatmap: With events 3-4 fixed at one trial each: bt_scaled(n1,n2) = 1/n1 + 4/n2 - 4/H(n1,n2) = -1/n1 + 2/n2, so the cell is component-admissible iff n2 <= 2*n1; D(n1,n2) = n2/(3*n2 + 3); G(n1,n2) = 1/(3 + 1/n1 + 1/n2).
closed_forms.psd_block_second_heatmap: With events 1-2 fixed at [1,100]: bt_scaled = -.98 for every cell, so every cell with n3,n4 >= 1 is inadmissible; D(n3,n4) = 1/(1.03 + 1/n3 + 1/n4); G(n3,n4) = 1/(2.01 + 1/n3 + 1/n4).
closed_forms.strict_pd_first_heatmap: bt_scaled(n1,n2) = -0.9/n1 + 2.1/n2 + 0.2 with events 3-4 at one trial each.
closed_forms.non_psd_block: Raw block [[1,3],[3,4]] (det -5): unscaled contrast variance c' Sb c = -1 at every cell; scaled form -2/n1 + 1/n2 is positive when n1 > 2*n2, so the single-observation (ICC) record is the only flag on those cells.

zero_count_convention: A cell with any zero entered/grid count reports 0 by the existing convention (local_dod_summary and the red note), is not a computed coefficient, and stays visible.
